stories.title: West Africa: gold rush reshapes the mining market [Business Africa]
stories.summary: Soaring gold prices are reshaping the investment landscape across West Africa. In the first quarter of 2026, global demand reached 1,231 tonnes, representing a record $193 billion market up 74% year-on-year.

stories.title: Cameroon defeat Morocco 3-1 to reach Women’s AFCON final
stories.summary: Cameroon are through to the Women’s AFCON final after a dramatic penalty shootout against hosts Morocco. The two sides couldn’t be separated after 120 minutes, with Morocco missing a huge chance to seal the win when Fatima Tagnaout saw her penalty saved in the 118th minute.
